attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The last time I left, I told you Tomas Quell was missing","reason":"No earlier bulletins exist; this is the first bulletin."},{"span":"the Brine Coast League had burned a ferry","reason":"The briefing says Black Fen Raiders burned the ferry, not the League."},{"span":"The Black Fen Raiders have taken three settlements last week","reason":"The briefing only lists their faction size as 3 settlements; no conquest is given."},{"span":"Their numbers have grown steadily since the last skirmish","reason":"There is no growth or skirmish in the briefing."},{"span":"operating with no apparent fear of the Rim Dispatch","reason":"This is an unsupported claim about the Raiders' relationship to the Dispatch."},{"span":"despite the recent raids","reason":"No raids are mentioned in the briefing."},{"span":"the weather remains unremarkable","reason":"The briefing gives no weather information."}],"voice":2,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin pretends to have earlier bulletins and blames the ferry burning on the wrong faction. It also invents conquests and raids, and pads out the end with a meaningless claim that 'the date has not changed'. The voice is earnest and generic rather than dry and wry."}
